nodes.label: W3C SHACL Advanced Features (SHACL-AF) Rules & Target Extensions
nodes.description: Extension specification to W3C SHACL defining inferencing rules, SHACL node expressions, custom functions, and dynamic target definitions for graph transformation.

nodes.label: Khoja Arabic Root Extraction & Morphological Stemming Engine
nodes.description: Rule-based morphological stemming algorithm removing prefixes, suffixes, and inflections to map Arabic words to trilateral and quadrilateral roots.

nodes.label: FALCON (FN-DSA) Post-Quantum Lattice Signature Standard
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 206 standardized lattice-based digital signature scheme based on NTRU lattices and fast Fourier sampling, providing compact cryptographic signatures.

nodes.label: Temporal Graph Networks (TGN) Dynamic Memory Aggregator
nodes.description: Deep learning framework for dynamic continuous-time streaming graphs, maintaining node memory states and updating via temporal message-passing modules.

nodes.label: GraphRAG Hybrid Knowledge Graph & Vector Retrieval Engine
nodes.description: Information retrieval architecture combining multi-hop graph traversals with high-dimensional vector search to ground LLM generation in verified subgraphs.
